text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After getting an invite from Vivlos for a "Dubai Talk Session,"
I came with her to a cafe.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I gathered heaps of new info,
so I'll share tons of it with Ai-san and the others♪

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you. Whether it's Dubai or anywhere else,
information from overseas is always great stimulation, so I can't wait!
choice_data_list: Yeah, for now, let's order some food.
Yeah, for now, let's order some food.

text_block_list.name: Ai & Verxina
text_block_list.text: (Chomp♪)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Mmm, this is delicious! ...They also have quite a good selection of health foods over there, don't they?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, exactly! Another healthy-style
restaurant just opened recently too~.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
!
This carrot is so sweet...!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Right! ...Oh, that's right! In Dubai, too,
there's this new carrot frappé shop~.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: So, as for the clothing trends~

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: (Chomp♪)

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Racecourses are evolving too, you know!
For example~...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: (Chomp♪)

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Aha♪
Ai-san is just constantly munching on something, so adooorable~♡

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Huh?!
choice_data_list: Yeah, it's refreshing seeing you eat like that.
Yeah, it's refreshing watching you eat with such gusto.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
T-True... Did I eat too much?
Calorie-wise, I should still be okay, though.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh! You were calculating your calories while eating?
That's amazing! It's like second nature to you.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
It's part of my training to eat larger portions, you see.
...In the past, I couldn't eat anywhere near as much as I do now.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I used to calculate so hard just to somehow hit my required calorie intake.
...Quite the opposite of now, isn't it!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Still... was that, um, a bit unladylike of me?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Ever since I became able to eat larger portions, eating has been so much fun...
I was trying to be careful, but...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Not at all! It was suuper super cute!
...Actually, kind of made me hungry too!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
So, right? Let's eat more~?
Let's feast like crazy~?♡
choice_data_list: Just keep it within your calories for today, alright?
Just keep it within your calories for today, okay?
We get plenty of exercise normally, so let's eat without worrying!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
So, right? Let's eat more~?
Let's feast like crazy~?♡
choice_data_list: Just keep it within your calories for today, alright?
Just keep it within your calories for today, okay?
We get plenty of exercise normally, so let's eat without worrying!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Which means... I have room for one more piece of cake.
I wonder which one I should get...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
The seasonal fruit tart looks so delicious~!
Oh, and they recommend the carrot souffle cake too!
And then, and then~!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Geez!
Don't be so mean, Vivlos-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
You're right! If we don't eat a ton,
we'll end up losing way too much weight!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
All right!
Then I'll feed you with an 'Ahhh♡'♪

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what!?
Vil-chan, stop, stop...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...And so, Almond Eye and the others happily ate their fill together!
